The benchmark's ROLE is nonetheless authoritatively sourced - EIA states 'The prices of Dubai and Oman crudes, both of which are medium and sour, are often averaged to create a benchmark that is typically used to price crude oil produced in the Middle East and exported to Asian markets' and that Saudi Aramco uses Dubai/Oman when pricing crude sold for delivery to Asia.
